verified_facts.text: The resort is set within the Tavolara Marine Reserve, a short distance from Lu Impostu beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reconnect with nature in a stunning resort setting within the Tavolara Marine Reserve, a short distance from the incomparable Lu Impostu beach

verified_facts.text: The resort is located on Sardinia's northeast coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on Sardinia’s northeast coast, this peaceful resort

verified_facts.text: The Sunset Terrace is a rooftop terrace above the Pool Bar for sunset aperitifs with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elegant rooftop terrace above the Pool Bar, perfect for sipping an unforgettable sunset aperitif with the sea on the horizon.

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa has a steam room, sauna and cooling ice fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with steam room, sauna, and cooling ice fountain

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa has a couples' treatment room, with a hot tub soak and an aperitivo after the massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our sophisticated **couples’ treatment room** invites you to unwind together. After your massage, soak in the hot tub and toast wellness with a **refreshing _aperitivo._**

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa treatments and services are also available to guests not staying at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: All our treatments and services are also available to those who are not staying at **Baglioni Resort Sardinia.**

verified_facts.text: The Baglioni Kids Club offers sports, games, arts and crafts and entertainment for young guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Baglioni Kids Club, our youngest guests can enjoy a variety of activities, such as sports, games, arts & crafts, entertainment & more.

verified_facts.text: Guests can play golf at Puntaldia Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take the opportunity to play golf at Puntaldía Golf Club

verified_facts.text: Guided horseback rides go along La Cinta beach and lagoon at dawn or sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ride along Sardinia’s iconic La Cinta beach and lagoon at dawn or sunset, guided by local experts

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a cooking class with the chefs of Gusto by Sadler.
verified_facts.excerpt: An opportunity to learn first-hand the chefs of our own Michelin-starred restaurant, Gusto by Sadler.

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include a Tavolara boat tour, diving and snorkeling in Tavolara, and kayaking in the marine area of La Tavolara.
Experiences offered include a Sardinia helicopter tour.
Experiences offered include canyoning on Rio Pitrisconi.
The rooms have spacious verandas with private gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Natural tones, authentic materials and spacious verandas with private gardens

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop Terrace Suite has a rooftop terrace with 360-degree sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Rooftop Terrace Suite accommodates up to four guests and features a living area, veranda, and rooftop terrace with 360° sea views.

verified_facts.text: The 2-Bedroom Family Room has two connecting bedrooms, two bathrooms and a private veranda with garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for families, this room features two connecting bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a private veranda with garden

verified_facts.text: The Garden Suite rate includes daily breakfast and guaranteed beach access with an umbrella.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Daily breakfast included at the restaurant
- Complimentary welcome bottle of wine
- Evening turndown service
- Fully stocked minibar with snacks and alcoholic & non-alcoholic beverages
- Guaranteed beach access with umbrella

verified_facts.text: The Grand Deluxe Room (Garden View) has Orosei stone flooring.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring soft tones and Orosei stone flooring, the Grand Deluxe Room offers a private veranda with garden

verified_facts.text: A Sardinian evening at Ristorante Mirto pairs a typical four-course menu with folk music and traditional dances.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Sardinian tradition with a typical four-course menu or à la carte options, accompanied by folk music and traditional dances
